2607.22013.title: Visual Saliency Steering Distillation for Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
2607.22013.paper_summary: Multimodal chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning integrates visual and textual cues through step-by-step inference. In small models with limited token budgets, modality-interaction fusion often suppresses tiny cross-modal differences. In particular, multimodal CoT often struggles when different images pair with identical text or different texts pair with an identical image, making such inputs nearly indistinguishable after fusion. This study proposes Visual Saliency Steering Distillation (VSSD). VSSD leverages the attention maps of multimodal large language models to generate perturbed images that capture task-sensitive feature directions, and then applies singular value decomposition to extract dominant steering vectors to guide inter-layer distillation. Experiments on ScienceQA and M$^3$CoT demonstrate that VSSD improves rationale generation and answer inference. The code is available at https://github.com/BGWH123/VSSD.
2607.22013.paper_summary_zh: 多模態思考鏈（CoT）推理通過逐步推理整合視覺和文本線索。在有限的標記預算的小型模型中，模態互動融合通常會抑制微小的跨模態差異。特別是，當不同的圖像與相同的文本配對或不同的文本與相同的圖像配對時，多模態 CoT 通常會遇到困難，使得這些輸入在融合後幾乎無法區分。本研究提出了視覺顯著性引導蒸餾（VSSD）。VSSD 利用多模態大型語言模型的注意力圖生成擾動圖像，以捕捉任務敏感的特徵方向，然後應用奇異值分解提取主導的引導向量以指導層間蒸餾。在 ScienceQA 和 M$^3$CoT 上的實驗表明，VSSD 改進了推理生成和答案推斷。代碼可在 https://github.com/BGWH123/VSSD 獲得。
